brief.headline: Odesa port blockade touted; Ukrainian drones kill civilians in Voronezh, Crimea
brief.lead: The monitored channels celebrated Russian strikes paralyzing Odesa-area ports and shipping while amplifying Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian regions that killed civilians, including a 3-year-old in Voronezh. A new maritime-threat frame — Ukrainian naval drones in the Atlantic — spread across the network.

developments.title: Channels claim Odesa port blockade paralyzing Ukrainian exports
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed Russian strikes on Odesa and Yuzhnyi fuel/port infrastructure forced Maersk to halt operations, with cargo rerouted to Romanian and Danube ports; Poddubny claimed 80% of Ukrainian exports are blocked. Claims are unverified and framed to minimize global food-security impact.

developments.title: Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian regions reported with civilian deaths
developments.body: Channels reported a 3-year-old killed in Voronezh (nine homes damaged), two civilians killed and five wounded in Crimea, and repeated strikes on Belgorod including a gas-station queue and a wedding registry office. Casualty claims are channel-sourced and unconfirmed; framing stresses deliberate targeting of civilians.

developments.title: Claimed advances in Zaporizhzhia/Hulyaipole sector
developments.body: Channels claimed Russian forces broke Ukrainian lines west of Novoselivka (1.5 sq km captured, mass surrenders) and the 36th motorized brigade seized Blahodatne. Claims are channel-sourced and unconfirmed by independent sources.

developments.title: Belitske claimed captured in Pokrovsk-Dobropillia axis
developments.body: Kotsnews claimed Russian forces captured Belitske in Donetsk and continue advancing from Hryshino toward Dobropillia; Two Majors reported the 33rd Guards regiment destroying armor in the Dobropolsky sector. Unconfirmed gains.

developments.title: New frame: Ukrainian naval drones threatening Atlantic shipping
developments.body: Rybar and Two Majors pushed claims that Ukraine deployed marine unmanned explosive devices in the Atlantic and armed a fishing vessel near the Arctic Pioneer tanker, arguing threats to Russian and global commercial shipping now extend beyond the Black Sea. Unverified.

developments.title: Channels report stalled US-Russia diplomacy after Lavrov-Rubio talks
developments.body: Channels reported Lavrov and Rubio met with Russia demanding an end to weapons supplies and no movement on core issues; Kotsnews claimed the 'Anchorage deal' collapsed with Rubio admitting no concrete proposals existed. Sentiment neutral-to-negative on any near-term settlement.

narrative_watch.title: Atlantic naval-drone threat expands the maritime narrative
narrative_watch.body: Rybar and Two Majors are constructing a frame that Ukrainian unmanned boats now menace global shipping in the Atlantic, escalating the sea-drone story well beyond the Black Sea.

narrative_watch.title: Port strikes reframed as debunking Ukrainian 'food security' claims
narrative_watch.body: Channels insist Odesa strikes prove Ukrainian and Western food-security warnings are exaggerated and serve third-party interests, converting a strike-reporting story into an information-war talking point.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine as demographically doomed and hostile to Donbas
narrative_watch.body: Rybar amplifies claims of Ukrainian mortality soaring to 260k yearly and a 1:4 birth-death ratio, while multiple channels highlight a Ukrainian commander allegedly dehumanizing Donbas residents.

mood_lines.text: Uniformly triumphant (net +100); channels frame Odesa/Yuzhnyi port strikes as a decisive, blockade-tightening success against Ukrainian exports and logistics.
Confident (net +80) on claimed gains at Blahodatne, Belitske and Novoselivka, plus mass-surrender claims in Zaporizhzhia and Dobropillia sectors.
Sharply negative (net -58, a 42-point swing) amid reported civilian deaths in Voronezh and Crimea and repeated Belgorod strikes.
Mixed-negative (net -17); stalled Lavrov-Rubio talks, new US-Ukraine drone production, offset by schadenfreude over Houthi/Iran pressure on US assets.
Down 40 points to net -20; Abkhazia/Georgia blackout, Crimea degradation and a debunked Siberian river project weighed against air-defense wins.
Single hostile post amplifying a Ukrainian commander's alleged dehumanizing remarks about Donbas residents.

flag_texts.title: Sentiment on Ukrainian strikes swings sharply negative
flag_texts.body: Ukraine strikes on Russia fell to net -58 (a 42-point move) as channels concentrated on civilian casualties — a 3-year-old killed in Voronezh, two dead in Crimea, and repeated Belgorod attacks.

flag_texts.title: Russia-internal mood drops 40 points
flag_texts.body: Sentiment on domestic topics slid to net -20, driven by reports of the Inguri plant accident blacking out Abkhazia and Georgia and admissions of ongoing Crimea infrastructure degradation.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin-criticism topics stay silent
flag_texts.body: Watchlist items 'Mobilisation rumours' and 'Criticism of Putin' produced no posts today; the sole criticism post targeted a Ukrainian commander, not Russian authorities.
